Title: Remote Desktop (RDP) activity
Description: Who connected over RDP, from which address, and when they logged on, reconnected, disconnected or failed.

Title: Logon summary
Description: Successful and failed logons per user and computer, with counts and first/last time.

Title: Failed logons and password guessing
Description: Failed logons, account lockouts and failed Kerberos or NTLM authentication.

Title: Admin and special-privilege logons
Description: Logons with administrator rights, explicit credentials and new-credential logons.

Title: File share access
Description: Network share connections and file access over SMB. Often the footprint of lateral movement.

Title: Remote execution (WinRM, WMI, PowerShell remoting)
Description: Remote PowerShell sessions and WMI activity.

Title: Lateral movement (MITRE tag)
Description: Every rule tagged as lateral movement, whatever the event.

Title: PowerShell activity
Description: PowerShell script blocks, engine starts, downgrade attempts and suspicious commands.

Title: Programs started and suspicious commands
Description: Process creation and related Sysmon events. Needs process auditing (4688) or Sysmon on the machine.

Title: Persistence (services, scheduled tasks, startup)
Description: New or changed services and scheduled tasks, and registry autostart changes.

Title: Accounts created, changed or added to groups
Description: New users, password resets, group membership changes and deleted accounts.

Title: Antivirus detections and protection changes
Description: Windows Defender detections, actions taken and any time protection was turned off or changed.

Title: Software installs and firewall changes
Description: MSI installs and removals, and Windows Firewall rule changes.

Title: USB and external devices
Description: When USB storage and other devices were plugged in.

Title: Hidden or encoded commands (base64)
Description: Finds and decodes base64 text inside events, such as encoded PowerShell.

Title: Logs cleared or tampered with
Description: Event logs cleared or stopped, audit policy changed, system time changed.

Title: Most serious alerts only
Description: High and critical findings from every rule. The quickest first look.

Title: Full timeline from every rule
Description: Runs all rules on all logs and builds one timeline. Slower, with the largest output.

Title: What is in these logs (event counts)
Description: How many events of each ID, per channel.

Title: Which log files and what date range
Description: Each log file with its size and first and last event time. Shows gaps and missing logs.

Title: Users, hosts and addresses worth following
Description: Keywords from the alerts (users, computers, IPs, processes) to search for next.
